initial_state_population.weights: uniform over nine profiles as in R12

candidate: Actual selected NBO policy, with the same torch proposal, inward guard, protected drift, and clipped-innovation recurrence as actor_verifier.verify.
checkpoint_selection: Already selected by registered actual online stopping; mechanism noise is independent of fitting, validation, online stopping and primary confirmation. No mechanism outcome can change the selected policy.
node_law: One independent uniform K in {0,...,N-1} for each independently simulated complete candidate trajectory.
reference: Deterministic cell-average schedule pi_k=midpoint(M_k)/h on the SAME global assessment grid.
critic: Selected split scalar postdecision critic; date input is t_(K+1), state input is postdecision mean before current noise. Reinstantiate known noise lift with h=1/2048. N_train remains separately recorded.
bank_law: Two conditionally independent banks. Within each bank two independent base Gaussian paths and their exact negatives; clip at +/-10 before pairing. No independence assertion within a pair.
randomness_seed_derivation: first eight SHA256 bytes big endian, modulo 2**64; independent purpose and stream domains

statistic_definitions.M: N times actual approximate-Q advantage using scalar continuation at the two endpoints.
statistic_definitions.A: T times squared normalized action deviation from cell-average reference.
statistic_definitions.E: T times cross inner product of critic errors against two independent derivative banks; retain signed observations.
statistic_definitions.D: N times global-curvature quadratic-support upper bound on actual feasible actor Q-gap; endpoint fallback when curvature is not negative.
statistic_definitions.E_raw: T/2 times squared normalized difference of the two banks; antithetic4 direct-costate MSE on SAME NBO occupation.
statistic_definitions.E_minus_raw: Paired difference E-E_raw; an upper confidence endpoint below zero establishes evaluation-subproblem risk reduction.

range_rule: Explicit deterministic coefficient and Gaussian concentration formulas in new_proofs.tex and costate_bridge.py, fixed v=8. Saved coefficient-derived ranges may differ by frozen checkpoint. No empirical maximum supplies a population bound.
arithmetic_rule: Protected polynomial tanh/log, outward scalar weights and neural values/gradients, proved vector-adjoint forward error, and interval sample moments. Rounded candidate actions held fixed in exact-state comparison. Save all numerical allowances.

confidence.allocation: 2 dimensions times 6 pooled statistics; no per-stream inferential endpoint.
confidence.theorem: Maurer-Pontil (2009) Theorem 11 for independent possibly nonidentical bounded variables; two-sided log(4/event_alpha).

pooling: Equal 256 independent bridge rows from every one of the 16 declared streams, maximum proved range, average tail/numerical allowances; no post hoc stream exclusion.
economic_endpoint: L_M-sqrt(U_A*U_E)-D_hold-E_all; use nonnegative upper risk/action endpoints. Optional quadratic actor-gap bound only when verified minimum curvature modulus is positive. Raw actual policy welfare is assessed only by the separately registered direct method contrasts.
work_scope: Independent post-selection mechanism-assessment work, reported separately from actual primary stopping work; charge loading, constants, all target paths and output I/O.
fallback_rule: Retain every analytical-schedule fallback as a deterministic zero-gain stream. Set all six bridge/evaluation-work statistics and allowances to zero for that stream; the costate-risk estimand is the registered evaluation subproblem for streams actually deploying an NBO critic, with zero mass at fallback. Never drop a stream.
failure_rule: A mechanism execution failure is retained and prevents a complete protected mechanism endpoint; it does not alter the primary policy or direct welfare result. No replacement seeds or adaptive sample increases.
freeze_rule: All design choices above fixed before first confirmatory outcome; numerical producer and source closure frozen before execution. Development verification uses manufactured small problems and does not inspect confirmatory snapshots.
